zone.zone_name: Office and Light Industrial OL-2/Multifamily Affordable Housing Overlay (§ 245-83)
zone.applies_to: OL-2 zone: Block 7, Lots 8 and 9; Block 6, Lot 14; Block 116, Lots 5.01-5.52 and 6 (north side of Route 46 / Boulevard)
zone.permitted_uses: Uses of the underlying OL-2 zone (§ 245-79), plus multifamily inclusionary development of townhouses and/or multifamily dwellings, with accessory recreation facilities and amenities for residents
zone.setbacks: Front 75 ft; side 50 ft; rear 75 ft; 50-ft landscaped buffer to any residential zone boundary
zone.parking: Per NJ RSIS; no parking within 50 ft of a front lot line or 25 ft of any other lot line
zone.other_standards: Max 8 townhouse units per building; max 16 units in a two-story and 24 units in a three-story multifamily building. Building spacing: windowless-windowless 25 ft, window-windowless 30 ft, window-window front-to-front 75 ft, rear-to-rear 50 ft, end-to-end 35 ft. Density raised from 14 to 16 du/ac and set-aside from 15% rental/20% sale to 20% (Third Round overlay amended). Affordable units per Article XVII (Affordable Housing Ordinance). max_units = Table 23 total for the sites in this zone.
